subject: Halcyon Health: pre-demo security sync & sample artifact handoff
messages:
From: Evan Morris <evan.morris@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace Lin <procurement@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security prep for upcoming eval — scheduling and artifacts

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking this on. We have an internal evaluation of inference vendors next week and want to run a focused security prep call to go over your CAIQ responses, log retention behavior, and sample audit artifacts.

Can we block 45 minutes sometime Wednesday or Thursday US PT? Our security lead (cc'd separately) will want to walk through where tokens and logs flow, and procurement would like to confirm the audit window for SOC 2 evidence.

We can share a short questionnaire beforehand — also would appreciate a handful of sample logs and a short README describing redaction/PII controls.

Thanks,
Evan
--
Evan Morris
Head of Security Programs
Halcyon Health
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Morris <evan.morris@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Lin <procurement@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security prep for upcoming eval — scheduling and artifacts

Hi Evan — great to meet you (virtually). Wednesday 2026-05-05, 10:00–10:45am PT or Thursday 2026-05-06, 1:00–1:45pm PT both work for us.

Quick notes on what we'll bring:
- A 30-minute walkthrough of our CAIQ highlights and where controls map to your intake questions.
- A 10–15 minute live demo of logging and key retention settings (redacted sample).
- An artifact packet: brief README, sample-logs (redacted), and SOC 2 scope doc.

Marissa will lead the technical parts; Kimberly will own procurement/SLA questions during the call.

I'll attach a short precall agenda and an upload link for your questionnaire. If you prefer a different time, let me know and we'll adjust.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Security & Trust Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_precall_agenda_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Morris <evan.morris@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security prep for upcoming eval — scheduling and artifacts

Hi all — quick technical checklist before the call:
- I'll bring: architecture diagram, our KV cache redaction doc, and an example of a log export (tar.gz) with a README explaining what fields are scrubbed.
- For the sample logs: we will provide 3 rotating-hour slices (redacted) and a small synthetic request trace. File names: sample-log-20260501-01.tar.gz etc.
- Access notes: for log transfer we'll use a short-lived S3 link; I'll include an access-instructions.md with presigned URL TTL and contact for any issues.

Evan: can you confirm whether you need raw request/response token counts per trace or just anonymized request metadata?

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Evan Morris <evan.morris@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace Lin <procurement@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security prep for upcoming eval — scheduling and artifacts

Thanks Marissa — that sounds good. We only need anonymized request metadata and token counts; no PII or raw responses. You can redact request text entirely and provide the token counts as a separate column.

Also, our SOC 2 auditor (Morgan & Co.) will likely ask for a seven-day log retention example and the mechanism for preserving chain-of-custody for exported artifacts. I'll forward their contact after procurement clears NDAs.

Please proceed with the S3 transfer approach and share presigned URLs 24 hours before the scheduled call.

Evan
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Morris <evan.morris@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Lin <procurement@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Thu 2026-05-06 1:00pm PT — security precall and artifacts handed off

Hi Evan / Grace — confirming Thursday 2026-05-06 1:00–1:45pm PT for the precall. Agenda attached and S3 links will go out tomorrow morning (2026-05-07) with 48-hour TTL.

Action items captured:
- Marissa: prepare redacted log slices + README + chain-of-custody notes (attachment: sample-log-extracts.tar.gz, access-instructions.md).
- Kimberly: prepare procurement brief on SOC 2 scope and any deviation options for retention windows.
- Lauren: upload agenda and add DocuSign link for the NDAs (see related link).

If Morgan & Co. need direct access, please have procurement share the auditor contact and we'll arrange a scoped artifact handoff. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Security & Trust Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sample-log-extracts.tar.gz (tar.gz); access-instructions.md (text)
